verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to bulk-import historical events from another analytics tool or a data export into Pendo. Track Events sent as REST API calls are live ingestion, not a historical backfill or import. 'Retroactive analytics' covers data Pendo itself captured from day one. Data Sync is an outbound export, and bulk delete is a different feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import historical events from another analytics tool or a data export into the platform
